_doc: One shared model corpus, independent expected cells/text where specified, plus an IEEE-bit-pattern corpus judged against Node String(Number). Fixture expectations are asserted on both sides, including NUL pair identity.
text_note: IEEE-754 bit patterns: named boundaries, every positive power of two and both immediate neighbors (-1074..1023), and 1000 distinct finite values from the fixed seed. Node String is the independent oracle.
